meta.title: About us | TourLink
meta.description: TourLink is a DMC and tour operator in Central Asia. Learn about our mission, history, and approach to travel across Uzbekistan and the region.

hero.title: About
hero.description: A DMC and tour operator in Central Asia — we design routes where place, people, and the rhythm of the journey work as one.

intro.title: Your link to Central Asia
intro.description: TourLink grew from the team, routes, and regional experience of Orient Star Group. We are a DMC based in Tashkent with programs across five countries in the region.
intro.paragraph: We do more than organize trips — we create the conditions for travelers to feel the essence of each place: through contact with locals, exchange of ideas, and immersion in traditions. Uzbekistan is our home, and a route can lead to the mountains of Kyrgyzstan, the steppes of Kazakhstan, and the desert roads of Turkmenistan.

mission.title: Journeys that stay in memory
mission.description: We go beyond standard tours: every TourLink program is designed by our team without intermediaries, with a focus on authenticity and quality.
mission.quote: We speak our clients' language and become not only guides but companions along the way — so every traveler feels at home while discovering the wonders we have carefully prepared.

why.title: What sets us apart as a DMC
why.description: Six reasons agencies and travelers choose TourLink for routes across Central Asia.

experience.title: 15+ years in tourism
experience.description: A team with deep experience in Central Asia — from route planning to on-the-ground coordination.

languages.title: Multilingual team
languages.description: Russian, English, Spanish, Italian, German, Japanese, and more — for seamless communication with clients.

individual.title: Individual approach
individual.description: Routes, transport, and accommodation tailored to dates, pace, group size, and each client's preferences.

routes.title: Exclusive routes
routes.description: From cities of the Thousand and One Nights to lesser-known corners of the Silk Road — with local experts.

quality.title: Quality of service
quality.description: Reliable partners for accommodation, transport, and guides. Comfort and safety are our top priorities.

sustainability.title: Sustainable tourism
sustainability.description: Working with local communities, preserving cultural authenticity, and minimizing environmental impact.

history.title: From idea to regional leader
history.description: Key milestones that shaped TourLink and the Orient Star Group team.
history.intro: TourLink's story grew from the path of Orient Star Group — from Surxon Mobile in 2006 to a DMC in Central Asia. Over the years the team welcomed thousands of foreign travelers, ran dozens of FAM trips, and reached international trade fairs — before launching the new TourLink brand in 2026.

founding.title: The beginning
founding.description: Founded as Surxon Mobile — flight booking and exploration of international destinations.

dmc.title: DMC status
dmc.description: Obtained DMC status and became a tour operator in Central Asia. Operations in Russian, English, and Spanish — with Uzbekistan at the heart of every route.

expansion.title: Growing arrivals
expansion.description: Welcoming 400 to 800 foreign tourists each year. Strengthening a leading position in Uzbekistan's tourism industry.

rebuild.title: Post-pandemic relaunch
rebuild.description: A six-month pause and rebirth from August. A new team speaking seven languages, full upgrade of transport, accommodation, and tour packages.

fam_series.title: FAM and infotour series
fam_series.description: February through May — three infotours for operators from Spain, Italy, England, and Greece. From July — groups of 15–20 travelers.

market_leader.title: Market leader
market_leader.description: 250 tourists welcomed by year-end. Established as a leading agency among Uzbekistan's tour operators.

fam_network.title: Partner network
fam_network.description: Five FAM trips with 60+ companies from Spain, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, and Russia. A Fam Trip for Portuguese operators acclaimed in T-NEW magazine.

global_presence.title: Global presence
global_presence.description: Six trade fairs: FITUR, Puteshestvuy Moscow, TOP RESA Paris, TTG Rimini, Tourism Expo Japan Osaka, WTM London. By November — 2500+ tourists and 50+ partner agencies.

tourlink.title: TourLink launch
tourlink.description: Rebrand and launch of TourLink — a new DMC brand built on years of Orient Star Group experience. Same team, new name, and a digital platform for agencies and travelers.

cta.title: Ready to discover Central Asia with TourLink?
cta.description: Tell us your dates, format, and direction — we will propose a route that keeps the journey's rhythm and reveals the region.
